description:
2D roguelike action shooting.

A serious action shooting game optimized for smartphone operation.

An arcade-like action game that you can play seriously when you want to play.
The capture that changes with equipment.
A system designed to make item recovery comfortable.

Capture the mysterious ruins that change every time you play!

-action
You can fly around with your fingers without limit.
Flick to move, tap to shoot, long press and aim 360 degrees freely charge shot.
We will use these actions to capture randomly generated ruins.

-Item collection
There is a treasure box in the field, and the equipment drops by opening the treasure box or defeating enemy.
Annihilating the enemies in the field makes it possible to use an easy-to-use item recovery system, which allows you to select and retrieve items comfortably.
Let's change to stronger equipment and aim deep in the ruins.

-Roguelike game
If your life is lost and the game is over, your equipment will be lost and your second challenge will be from the beginning.
In order to move deeper, you will rely on the player's memory and skills.
What on earth are the things that wait in the back of the ruins ...
Aim for that and try challenging.
